author: Yffe
content: Scope update: item 1 (runtime effect sandbox) is now SHIPPED via #57 — forge build emits an fx-derived seccomp filter; declared effects are enforced at the syscall boundary (killed on violation), boundary/slag confined to their declared fx. The runnable-binary gate it needed was shipped as #56 (forge build). #21 now tracks only: (2) DIRECT MIR-level lowering (we transpile to Rust which rustc takes to MIR; the thesis is satisfied transitively, direct-MIR emission is an unneeded rewrite, candidate to reframe/close); (3) the incremental goal-state REPL (forge goal/fill; we do whole-item forge check).
